questions.question: During a fight in the Israelite camp, what serious thing did the son of an Israelite mother and Egyptian father do?

answers.text: He stole from another man's tent
He ran away from the camp

questions.question: In the law the LORD gave Moses, what must be done to a person who injures his neighbor?
The LORD said His law against blaspheming His name applied to native Israelites but not to foreign residents. True or false?
What reason did the LORD give for having one standard of law for foreign residents and native Israelites?

answers.text: He is the LORD their God
The tribes asked Him for it
Moses could not judge each case
